questions.question: Join `Customers` and `Orders` on `CustomerID` and select the Customer Name and Order Total.
questions.correctAnswer: SELECT Customers.Name, Orders.Total FROM Customers JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID;
acceptedAnswers: SELECT c.Name, o.Total FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
